semantics.after: an attempt is failed when it ends in story/retry or story/rollback; its failures are the failure/observed of its story after the later of its story/begin and the story's previous outcome, up to the outcome; a committed attempt is never a row; a story/begin clears what the story observed since its last outcome; rows equal to the row before are reported (unchanged)
semantics.before: an attempt is closed at story/retry, story/rollback and story/commit; each closer appends the sorted failures observed since the story's previous closer; rows equal to the row before are reported

shapes.shape: F_x retry | F_x commit (the committed attempt repeats the failures before it)
shapes.why: a retry that succeeded is progress; BASE called the committed attempt a repeated failed one (the owner's shape)

shapes.why: attempts 1 and 2 failed the same way; the commit is not a third failed attempt
the committed attempt differs from the one before: nothing reported either way

shapes.shape: F_x retry | late F_y | F_x rollback (a failure after an outcome, next attempt repeats F_x)
shapes.why: the failure journaled after the outcome is not attempt 2's: BASE carried it in and missed the repeat

shapes.shape: F_x,F_y retry | late F_x | F_y rollback (late failure would make attempt 2 look like attempt 1)
shapes.why: attempt 2 observed only F_y; BASE credited it the late F_x and called it a repeat of attempt 1
